entries.50a459caf069fa50: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,710 million (¥3,940 million in the previous year, up 19.5%), ordinary profit was ¥5,208 million (up 9.3%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥4,801 million (up 35.9%). The annual securities report states that, although the company recorded costs for countermeasures against defects in some products, the effect of higher revenue and the mix of products sold had a positive effect on profit. Selling, general and administrative expenses include a provision for product warranties of ¥1,416 million, and net income includes a gain on sale of investment securities of ¥1,242 million (extraordinary income). It states that revenue, operating profit, ordinary profit and net income were all record highs.
